```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  fig.width = 10,
  fig.height = 6,

# Load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(pointblank)
library(survival)
library(gtsummary)
library(survminer)
library(gt)
library(scales)

# Load the robustrwd package
devtools::load_all(here::here("robustrwd"))
be_quiet()

# Custom colors
plinth_blue <- "#4783F1"
plinth_green <- "#28a745"
plinth_red <- "#dc3545"
plinth_orange <- "#fd7e14"
plinth_gray <- "#6c757d"
```

```{r load-data}
# Load and process data
tables <- receive_delivery_02()
tables_clean <- tables %>% etl_02()

# Create ORPP table
orpp_tbl <- tables_clean$patients %>%
  add_orpp_inpatient(inpatient_tbl = tables_clean$inpatient) %>%
  add_orpp_prescription(prescription_tbl = tables_clean$prescription)
```

# Executive Summary {.tabset}

## Overview

<div class="summary-box">

This report presents a comprehensive data quality assessment and cohort analysis of Medicare claims data. The analysis pipeline includes:

- **Data Validation**: Automated quality checks using pointblank
- **ETL Processing**: Standardized data transformation pipeline
- **Cohort Definition**: Multi-criteria patient selection
- **Survival Analysis**: Kaplan-Meier estimation by demographic groups

</div>

## Key Metrics

```{r key-metrics}
# Calculate key metrics
n_patients <- nrow(tables_clean$patients)
n_inpatient_claims <- nrow(tables_clean$inpatient)
n_prescriptions <- nrow(tables_clean$prescription)
n_outpatient <- nrow(tables_clean$outpatient)

tibble(
  Metric = c("Total Patients", "Inpatient Claims", "Prescription Records", "Outpatient Claims"),
  Count = c(n_patients, n_inpatient_claims, n_prescriptions, n_outpatient),
  `Formatted` = comma(Count)
) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md("**Data Volume Summary**"),
    subtitle = "Records processed in this analysis"
  ) %>%
  cols_hide(Count) %>%
  cols_label(Formatted = "Record Count") %>%
  tab_options(
    table.font.size = px(14),
    heading.title.font.size = px(18),
    heading.subtitle.font.size = px(14)
  ) %>%
  cols_align(align = "right", columns = Formatted)
```

# Data Quality Assessment {.tabset}

Automated data validation was performed using the `pointblank` framework. Each table underwent rigorous quality checks to ensure data integrity before analysis.

## Patients

```{r patients-validation}
patients_agent <- tables_clean$patients %>%
  create_agent(
    tbl_name = "Patients",
    label = "Patient Demographics Quality Assessment"
  ) %>%
  expectations_patients() %>%
  interrogate()

patients_agent
```

## Inpatient Claims

```{r inpatient-validation}
inpatient_agent <- tables_clean$inpatient %>%
  create_agent(
    tbl_name = "Inpatient Claims",
    label = "Inpatient Claims Quality Assessment"
  ) %>%
  expectations_inpatient() %>%
  interrogate()

inpatient_agent
```

## ORPP Table

```{r orpp-validation}
orpp_agent <- orpp_tbl %>%
  create_agent(
    tbl_name = "One Row Per Patient",
    label = "Derived ORPP Table Quality Assessment"
  ) %>%
  expectations_orpp() %>%
  interrogate()

orpp_agent
```

## Validation Summary

```{r validation-summary}
# Summarize all validations
validation_summary <- tibble(
  Table = c("Patients", "Inpatient Claims", "ORPP"),
  `Total Tests` = c(
    nrow(patients_agent$validation_set),
    nrow(inpatient_agent$validation_set),
    nrow(orpp_agent$validation_set)
  ),
  `Tests Passed` = c(
    sum(patients_agent$validation_set$all_passed),
    sum(inpatient_agent$validation_set$all_passed),
    sum(orpp_agent$validation_set$all_passed)
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    `Pass Rate` = percent(`Tests Passed` / `Total Tests`),
    Status = if_else(`Tests Passed` == `Total Tests`, "PASS", "REVIEW")
  )

validation_summary %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md("**Data Quality Summary**"),
    subtitle = "Validation results across all data tables"
  ) %>%
  data_color(
    columns = Status,
    colors = scales::col_factor(
      palette = c("PASS" = plinth_green, "REVIEW" = plinth_orange),
      domain = c("PASS", "REVIEW")
    )
  ) %>%
  tab_options(
    table.font.size = px(14)
  )
```

# Patient Demographics {.tabset}

## Population Overview

```{r demographics-table}
tables_clean$patients %>%
  select(sex_ident_cd, race_cd, diabetes, cncr, esrd_ind, death_observed) %>%
  tbl_summary(
    label = list(
      sex_ident_cd ~ "Sex",
      race_cd ~ "Race/Ethnicity",
      diabetes ~ "Diabetes",
      cncr ~ "Cancer History",
      esrd_ind ~ "End-Stage Renal Disease",
      death_observed ~ "Deceased"
    ),
    statistic = list(all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)")
  ) %>%
  modify_header(label ~ "**Characteristic**") %>%
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md("**Patient Population Characteristics**"),
    subtitle = glue::glue("N = {comma(n_patients)} patients")
  )
```

## Age Distribution

```{r age-distribution, fig.height=5}
tables_clean$patients %>%
  mutate(
    age_at_study = as.numeric(difftime(Sys.Date(), birth_dt, units = "days")) / 365.25
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = age_at_study)) +
  geom_histogram(fill = plinth_blue, color = "white", bins = 30, alpha = 0.8) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Patient Age",
    subtitle = "Age calculated from birth date to current date",
    x = "Age (years)",
    y = "Number of Patients"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma)
```

## Race/Ethnicity

```{r race-distribution, fig.height=5}
tables_clean$patients %>%
  count(race_cd, sort = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    pct = n / sum(n),
    race_cd = fct_reorder(race_cd, n)
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = race_cd, y = n, fill = race_cd)) +
  geom_col(alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(comma(n), " (", percent(pct, accuracy = 0.1), ")")),
            hjust = -0.1, size = 3.5) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Patient Distribution by Race/Ethnicity",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Number of Patients"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.2))) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2")
```

# Cohort Definition & Attrition

## Inclusion Criteria

The analysis cohort was defined using the following sequential criteria:

```{r criteria-table}
tibble(
  Step = 1:6,
  Criterion = c(
    "Race is White or Black",
    "Has Diabetes diagnosis",
    "Sex is Male",
    "Median inpatient payment >= $10,000",
    "Median prescription cost > $20",
    "At least 18 years of known survival"
  ),
  Rationale = c(
    "Focus on populations with sufficient sample size",
    "Target population of clinical interest",
    "Subset for focused analysis",
    "Patients with significant healthcare utilization",
    "Patients with ongoing medication needs",
    "Adequate follow-up for survival analysis"
  )
) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md("**Cohort Inclusion Criteria**")
  ) %>%
  cols_width(
    Step ~ px(60),
    Criterion ~ px(300),
    Rationale ~ px(350)
  ) %>%
  tab_options(table.font.size = px(13))
```

## Attrition Analysis

```{r attrition-table}
attrition_tbl <- create_attrition(
  orpp_tbl,
  "Race is White or Black" = race_cd %in% c("White", "Black"),
  "Has Diabetes" = diabetes == TRUE,
  "Sex is Male" = sex_ident_cd == "Male",
  "Median inpatient payment >= $10,000" = inpatient_payment_median >= 10000,
  "Median prescription cost > $20" = prescription_rx_cost_median > 20,
  "18+ years of known survival" = survival_years >= 18
)

attrition_tbl %>%
  mutate(
    `Retention Rate` = percent(n / first(n), accuracy = 0.1),
    n = comma(n),
    n_dropped = comma(n_dropped)
  ) %>%
  rename(
    Criterion = description,
    `Patients Remaining` = n,
    `Patients Excluded` = n_dropped
  ) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md("**Cohort Attrition Summary**"),
    subtitle = "Sequential application of inclusion criteria"
  ) %>%
  tab_options(table.font.size = px(13)) %>%
  sub_missing(missing_text = "-")
```

## Attrition Visualization

```{r attrition-plot, fig.height=7, fig.width=10}
plot_attrition(attrition_tbl, title = "Cohort Attrition Flow") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 11)
  )
```

# Final Cohort Analysis {.tabset}

```{r final-cohort}
cohort_tbl <- orpp_tbl %>%
  filter(
    race_cd %in% c("White", "Black"),
    diabetes == TRUE,
    sex_ident_cd == "Male",
    inpatient_payment_median >= 10000,
    prescription_rx_cost_median > 20,
    survival_years >= 18
  )
```

## Cohort Characteristics

```{r cohort-summary}
cohort_tbl %>%
  select(
    race_cd,
    survival_years,
    death_observed,
    inpatient_payment_median,
    prescription_rx_cost_median,
    inpatient_claims_n,
    prescription_n
  ) %>%
  tbl_summary(
    by = race_cd,
    label = list(
      survival_years ~ "Survival Time (years)",
      death_observed ~ "Death Observed",
      inpatient_payment_median ~ "Median Inpatient Payment ($)",
      prescription_rx_cost_median ~ "Median Rx Cost ($)",
      inpatient_claims_n ~ "Number of Inpatient Claims",
      prescription_n ~ "Number of Prescriptions"
    ),
    statistic = list(
      all_continuous() ~ "{median} ({p25}, {p75})",
      all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)"
    ),
    digits = list(
      all_continuous() ~ 1
    )
  ) %>%
  add_overall() %>%
  modify_header(label ~ "**Variable**") %>%
  bold_labels() %>%
  as_gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md("**Final Cohort Characteristics by Race**"),
    subtitle = glue::glue("N = {nrow(cohort_tbl)} patients meeting all inclusion criteria")
  )
```

## Survival Analysis

```{r survival-analysis, fig.height=8, fig.width=10}
fit <- survfit(
  Surv(survival_years, death_observed) ~ race_cd,
  data = cohort_tbl
)

ggsurvplot(
  fit,
  data = cohort_tbl,
  conf.int = TRUE,
  risk.table = TRUE,
  risk.table.col = "strata",
  risk.table.height = 0.25,
  surv.median.line = "hv",
  palette = c(plinth_blue, plinth_orange),
  ggtheme = theme_minimal(base_size = 14),
  title = "Kaplan-Meier Survival Curves by Race",
  xlab = "Time (Years)",
  ylab = "Survival Probability",
  legend.title = "Race",
  legend.labs = c("Black", "White"),
  font.title = c(16, "bold"),
  font.x = 14,
  font.y = 14,
  font.tickslab = 12
)
```

## Healthcare Utilization

```{r utilization-plot, fig.height=6}
cohort_tbl %>%
  select(race_cd, inpatient_payment_median, prescription_rx_cost_median) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(inpatient_payment_median, prescription_rx_cost_median),
    names_to = "cost_type",
    values_to = "amount"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    cost_type = case_when(
      cost_type == "inpatient_payment_median" ~ "Inpatient Payments",
      cost_type == "prescription_rx_cost_median" ~ "Prescription Costs"
    )
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = race_cd, y = amount, fill = race_cd)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.8, outlier.alpha = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~cost_type, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "Healthcare Cost Distribution by Race",
    subtitle = "Median values per patient",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Amount ($)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = dollar) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Black" = plinth_blue, "White" = plinth_orange))
```
